## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle excerpt from a larger Indian abhidharmic-Vinaya work, presenting the chapter (品 *pǐn*) on the **forms of monastic ordination** (出家相 *chūjiā xiàng*). Translated by **Paramārtha** 真諦 ([真諦](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9C%9F%E8%AB%A6)) at the Chén court in 558–569 CE.

**Abstract**

The *Fóāpítán* is an abhidharmic-Vinaya hybrid work — combining doctrinal-systematic analysis (*abhidharma*) with monastic-disciplinary content (*vinaya*). The "chapter on the forms of going-forth" expounds the doctrinal taxonomy of *upasaṃpadā* — the various modes by which monastic ordination is conferred (the early "ehi-bhikṣu" form, the *tisaraṇa* form, the *karmavācanā* form, etc.). The text is one of the few Sammitīya / Sāṃmatīya-affiliated works preserved in Chinese (cf. [KR6k0042](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0042) *Lǜ èrshíèr míngliǎo lùn*); Paramārtha's preference for Sammitīya material reflects his Indian background at Vālabhī, the school's principal centre.
